## Ysaqquan Toad (CR 1/2)

**XP** 200  
CE Diminutive magical beast (aquatic, mythos)  
**Init** +1; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +6  


**Defense**


**AC** 15, touch 15, flat-footed 14 (+1 Dex, +4 size)  
**hp** 11 (1d10+1)  
**Fort** +3; **Ref** +3; **Will** +2  
**Defensive Abilities** poisonous skin; **Immune** poison  


**Offense**


**Speed** 10 ft., climb 10 ft., swim 20 ft.  
**Melee** bite +6 (1d2–4 plus poison)  
**Space** 1 ft.; **Reach** 0 ft.  
**Special Attacks** poison (DC 11)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 3, **Dex** 12, **Con** 12, **Int** 7, **Wis** 15, **Cha** 10  
**Base Atk** +1; CMB—2; **CMD** 4 (8 vs. trip)  
**Feats** Weapon Finesse  
**Skills** Acrobatics +1 (+9 jump), Climb +9, Perception +6, Stealth +17, Swim +9; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Acrobatics (+8 when jumping), +4 Stealth, uses Dex to modify Climb and Swim  
**Languages** Common  


**Special Abilities**


**Poison (Ex)** Bite or skin—contact or injury; *save* Fort DC 11; *frequency* 1/round for 2 rounds; primary effect 1 Wisdom damage plus dazed for 1 round; secondary effect unconscious for 2d4 rounds plus special (see below); *cure* 1 save. The save DC is Constitution-based.  

**Poisonous Skin (Ex)** Any creature that touches an ysaqquan toad, such as with an unarmed strike or natural weapon, is exposed to its poison unless it succeeds on a DC 11 Reflex save. The save DC is Constitution-based.  


**About**


**Environment** any urban  
**Organization** solitary, pair, knot (3–12), or colony (13–100)  
**Treasure** none
